'''Demolition Unlimited''' is a surface Engineer base in the '''[[Eurybia]]''' system, and the workshop of '''[[Liz Ryder]]'''.<ref name="inara-demolition">[https://inara.cz/elite/station/52147/ Demolition Unlimited in Eurybia — Station], Inara.</ref>

== Location ==

* '''System:''' [[Eurybia]]
* '''Body:''' Makalu
* '''Landing pad:''' Large
* '''Permit required:''' No<ref name="inara-demolition" />

== Engineer ==

Demolition Unlimited is operated by '''[[Liz Ryder]]'''. See [[Liz Ryder]] for the full discovery, invitation, and unlock requirements to access her workshop.

== Station Services ==

Demolition Unlimited offers a commodity market, outfitting, rearmament, refuelling, repairs, and shipyard services, in addition to Liz's Engineering workshop.<ref name="inara-demolition" />
